It features brownish-grey plumage on the body and darker flight feathers. The head shows a long, heavy bill with a visible gular pouch area, though the coloration is muted (brownish-yellow) rather than bright breeding colors. The neck is retracted into an S-curve typical of flight. Legs are tucked back and partially obscured by the tail/body angle.
